en: Please try again.
zh: 请重试。

en: Your login attempt expired. Please start again.
zh: 登录尝试已过期，请重新开始。

en: Login cancelled. Your local clips are still here.
zh: 登录已取消。本地片段仍保留在这里。

en: Login could not finish. Please try again.
zh: 登录未能完成，请重试。

en: Shared storage used
zh: 已使用的分享存储空间

en: Shared clip removed. Your storage has been updated.
zh: 已移除分享片段，存储空间已更新。

en: Cancel thumbnail
zh: 取消生成缩略图

en: Thumbnail saved. Your original video is unchanged.
zh: 缩略图已保存，原始视频未更改。

en: Could not delete this clip. Please retry.
zh: 无法删除此片段，请重试。

en: Preparing your download with a Hopmodo banner and ending. Keep this tab open.
zh: 正在准备带有 Hopmodo 横幅和结尾的下载文件。请保持此标签页打开。

en: Download ready. Your preview and gallery upload keep the original video without promotional branding.
zh: 下载已就绪。预览和作品展廊上传仍使用不带宣传标识的原始视频。

en: Download cancelled. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 下载已取消，原始回放完好无损。

en: Preparing the final 55 seconds of gameplay without a promotional banner or ending. Keep this tab open; nothing is uploaded.
zh: 正在准备最后 55 秒的游戏内容，不含宣传横幅或结尾。请保持此标签页打开；不会上传任何内容。

en: Share copy ready at the top. Preview it, then choose whether to publish it.
zh: 分享副本已在顶部就绪。请先预览，再决定是否发布。

en: Share copy cancelled. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 分享副本制作已取消，原始回放完好无损。

en: With conversation. Preview this version before sharing.
zh: 包含对话。分享前请预览此版本。

en: Voice was recorded. Use the conversation track download if your browser blocks its playback.
zh: 声音已录制。如果浏览器阻止播放，请下载对话音轨。

en: Preparing a video with conversation on this device. This takes the replay length. Keep this tab open.
zh: 正在此设备上准备包含对话的视频，所需时间与回放时长相同。请保持此标签页打开。

en: Ready to download. This version could not be saved; download it before leaving.
zh: 已可下载。此版本无法保存，请在离开前下载。

en: Conversation version ready. The original and separate track are kept in My clips.
zh: 对话版本已就绪。原始视频和单独音轨都保留在“我的片段”中。

en: Preparation cancelled. Your original and conversation track are safe.
zh: 准备已取消，原始视频和对话音轨完好无损。

en: This browser cannot share video files directly. Download your clip, then attach it in your messaging app. Copy game link invites friends to play.
zh: 此浏览器无法直接分享视频文件。请下载片段，然后在聊天应用中作为附件发送。“复制游戏链接”可邀请朋友来玩。

en: Share dialog completed. Your clip is still saved here.
zh: 分享对话框已完成。片段仍保存在这里。

en: Sharing cancelled. Your clip is still here.
zh: 分享已取消，片段仍保留在这里。

en: Could not share this file. Download your clip and attach it in your messaging app.
zh: 无法分享此文件。请下载片段，然后在聊天应用中作为附件发送。

en: Game link copied. This invites friends to play; it does not include your private clip.
zh: 游戏链接已复制。此链接会邀请朋友来玩，不包含你的私密片段。

en: Copy this game link. Your clip stays on this device.
zh: 请复制此游戏链接。片段仍保留在此设备上。

en: Game link
zh: 游戏链接

en: Shared storage is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
zh: 分享存储空间不可用，请稍后重试。

en: Your 2 GB storage is full. Delete older videos from My shared clips to free space.
zh: 你的 2 GB 存储空间已满。请从“我分享的片段”中删除较早的视频以释放空间。

en: The shared 10 GB anonymous storage is full. Log in to use your own 2 GB, or try again later.
zh: 共用的 10 GB 匿名存储空间已满。请登录以使用自己的 2 GB 空间，或稍后重试。

en: Remove videos from My shared clips on any device.
zh: 可在任意设备上从“我分享的片段”中移除视频。

en: Keep this local clip on this browser to remove its public upload later.
zh: 请在此浏览器中保留本地片段，以便之后移除其公开上传。

en: Private: hidden from the public gallery. Anyone with your sharing link can watch and copy it, including friends without an account.
zh: 私密：不会显示在公开作品展廊中。任何获得分享链接的人都能观看和复制，包括没有账户的朋友。

en: Public: anyone can find this video in the gallery, watch it and copy it.
zh: 公开：任何人都能在作品展廊中找到、观看并复制此视频。

en: This local clip is no longer saved. Download it before leaving; upload was not started.
zh: 此本地片段已不再保存。请在离开前下载；上传尚未开始。

en: Private — people with the link can watch
zh: 私密 · 获得链接的人可以观看

en: This replay has no gameplay to copy.
zh: 此回放没有可复制的游戏内容。

en: This browser could not read the replay. Download the original or retry in an updated browser.
zh: 此浏览器无法读取回放。请下载原始文件，或在更新后的浏览器中重试。

en: Reading the replay took too long. Please retry.
zh: 读取回放用时过长，请重试。

en: Unsupported replay speed.
zh: 不支持此回放速度。

en: Share copy cancelled.
zh: 分享副本制作已取消。

en: Keep this tab visible while making a share copy. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 制作分享副本时请保持此标签页可见。原始回放完好无损。

en: Making the share copy took too long. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 制作分享副本用时过长。原始回放完好无损。

en: The replay duration is unavailable.
zh: 无法获取回放时长。

en: This copy exceeded its file limit. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 此副本超过文件限制。原始回放完好无损。

en: This browser could not encode the share copy. Your original replay is safe.
zh: 此浏览器无法编码分享副本。原始回放完好无损。

en: Replay highlights
zh: 回放精彩片段

en: Replay playback stalled. Keep this tab visible and retry.
zh: 回放播放停滞。请保持此标签页可见并重试。

en: Replay playback could not start. Please retry from the clip button.
zh: 无法开始播放回放。请通过片段按钮重试。

en: The share copy exceeded the website limits. Your full replay is still saved.
zh: 分享副本超过网站限制。完整回放仍然保存着。

en: The browser could not finish this recording.
zh: 浏览器无法完成此次录制。

en: Camera interrupted
zh: 摄像头中断

en: Could not save on this device.
zh: 无法保存到此设备。

en: Game closed
zh: 游戏已关闭

en: Preview ended
zh: 预览已结束

en: Recording is unavailable in this browser.
zh: 此浏览器无法录制。

en: Round restarted
zh: 本轮已重新开始

en: Game reloaded
zh: 游戏已重新加载

en: Conversation capture has finished for this round. Start another round to record more.
zh: 本轮对话录音已结束。开始新一轮即可继续录制。

en: Conversation recording stopped. The game video is still recording.
zh: 对话录音已停止，游戏视频仍在录制。

en: Conversation recording could not be saved. The game video is still available.
zh: 无法保存对话录音，游戏视频仍然可用。

en: Microphone recording is unavailable in this browser.
zh: 此浏览器无法使用麦克风录音。

en: Microphone permission took too long. Click Record conversation to retry.
zh: 麦克风权限请求用时过长。点击“录制对话”重试。

en: No microphone track is available.
zh: 没有可用的麦克风音轨。

en: Microphone disconnected. Your recorded video and conversation so far are kept.
zh: 麦克风已断开。已录制的视频和对话会保留。

en: Microphone permission was denied. You can still play without conversation.
zh: 麦克风权限被拒绝。你仍可在不录制对话的情况下游戏。

en: Microphone could not start. You can still play.
zh: 麦克风无法启动。你仍然可以玩。

en: This video exceeds the 200 MB upload limit. Make a smaller copy, then try again.
zh: 此视频超过 200 MB 上传限制。请制作较小的副本后重试。

en: Choose a supported sharing expiry.
zh: 请选择受支持的分享有效期。

en: Choose public or private visibility.
zh: 请选择公开或私密可见范围。

en: Confirm the selected visibility before uploading.
zh: 上传前请确认所选可见范围。

en: Use a title of 1–90 characters.
zh: 标题长度应为 1–90 个字符。

en: Unknown game or recording source.
zh: 未知的游戏或录制来源。

en: Record a clip of 90 seconds or less.
zh: 请录制不超过 90 秒的片段。

en: Use an MP4 or WebM recording.
zh: 请使用 MP4 或 WebM 录制文件。

en: Use a nonempty video with a valid size.
zh: 请使用非空且大小有效的视频。

en: Empty recording.
zh: 录制内容为空。

en: Media exceeds its size limit.
zh: 媒体文件超过大小限制。

en: This recording is too short to be a video.
zh: 录制内容过短，无法作为视频。

en: Gallery identity is not configured.
zh: 作品展廊身份尚未配置。

en: Gallery authentication is unavailable. Please try later.
zh: 作品展廊身份验证不可用，请稍后重试。

en: This clip has expired or was removed.
zh: 此片段已过期或被移除。

en: The gallery is unavailable. Try again shortly.
zh: 作品展廊不可用，请稍后重试。

en: Anonymous storage inventory is unavailable.
zh: 匿名存储清单不可用。

en: Log in again before publishing this clip.
zh: 发布此片段前请重新登录。

en: Publish or remove clips from the arcade website.
zh: 在游戏大厅网站发布或移除片段。

en: Use the device that published this clip to manage it.
zh: 请使用发布此片段的设备进行管理。

en: Sharing is unavailable.
zh: 分享功能不可用。

en: Invalid upload report.
zh: 上传报告无效。

en: Account sharing is unavailable. Please try again later.
zh: 账户分享不可用，请稍后重试。

en: Shared clip ownership could not be verified.
zh: 无法验证分享片段的所有权。

en: Invalid gallery page.
zh: 作品展廊页面无效。

en: The gallery could not load. Please retry.
zh: 无法加载作品展廊，请重试。

en: Clip not found.
zh: 未找到片段。

en: Community publishing is being connected. Your local clips remain on this device.
zh: 社区发布功能正在接入。本地片段仍保留在此设备上。

en: An upload is finishing. Please retry removal shortly.
zh: 上传即将完成，请稍后重试移除。

en: An upload is finishing. Please retry shortly.
zh: 上传即将完成，请稍后重试。

en: Log in is being connected. Your local clips remain on this device.
zh: 登录功能正在接入。本地片段仍保留在此设备上。

en: Log in to upload a private clip.
zh: 请登录以上传私密片段。

en: Anonymous shares expire after 7 days. Log in to choose another expiry.
zh: 匿名分享会在 7 天后过期。登录后可选择其他有效期。

en: A device management key is required for anonymous uploads.
zh: 匿名上传需要设备管理密钥。

en: Another clip is uploading. Please retry shortly.
zh: 另一个片段正在上传，请稍后重试。

en: This clip was published by another account.
zh: 此片段由另一个账户发布。

en: The recording does not match its video format.
zh: 录制内容与其视频格式不匹配。

en: Upload did not finish. Check your shared clips before retrying.
zh: 上传未完成。重试前请检查已分享片段。

en: Anonymous storage ownership could not be verified.
zh: 无法验证匿名存储所有权。

en: Could not free anonymous storage. Please retry shortly.
zh: 无法释放匿名存储空间，请稍后重试。

en: Publication did not finish. Check My shared clips before retrying.
zh: 发布未完成。重试前请检查“我分享的片段”。

en: Upload was interrupted. Check My shared clips before retrying.
zh: 上传已中断。重试前请检查“我分享的片段”。

en: Could not remove this upload. Please retry.
zh: 无法移除此上传，请重试。

en: Could not remove the thumbnail. Please retry.
zh: 无法移除缩略图，请重试。

en: Account sharing is unavailable.
zh: 账户分享不可用。

en: Only the account that published this clip can remove it.
zh: 只有发布此片段的账户才能将其移除。

en: Could not remove this clip. Please retry.
zh: 无法移除此片段，请重试。

en: The link was removed. Retry removal in My shared clips to release its storage.
zh: 链接已移除。请在“我分享的片段”中重试移除，以释放存储空间。

en: Could not remove the thumbnail. Please retry removal.
zh: 无法移除缩略图，请重试移除。

en: Only the publishing account can add this thumbnail.
zh: 只有发布账户可以添加此缩略图。

en: Confirm sharing before uploading a thumbnail.
zh: 上传缩略图前请确认分享。

en: Use a JPEG thumbnail.
zh: 请使用 JPEG 缩略图。

en: Thumbnail must be no larger than 256 KiB.
zh: 缩略图不得超过 256 KiB。

en: The thumbnail is not a JPEG.
zh: 缩略图不是 JPEG 格式。

en: Video published, but its thumbnail could not be saved. Retry publishing to finish it.
zh: 视频已发布，但缩略图无法保存。请重试发布以完成操作。

en: Method not allowed.
zh: 不允许此请求方法。

en: Invalid byte range.
zh: 字节范围无效。

en: This video is unavailable.
zh: 此视频不可用。

en: Not found.
zh: 未找到。

en: The gallery is unavailable. Please try again later.
zh: 作品展廊不可用，请稍后重试。
